nodes.label: Sidecar seccomp profile
nodes.rationale: Docker default profile plus one rule allowing clone/clone3/unshare/setns so Chromium's own sandbox works; any more syscalls need security review.

nodes.label: Decisions Log
nodes.rationale: Records choices such as self-hosted Docker, JSON-LD import with human review, HTTPS from M1, no email in MVP.

nodes.label: Deployment Targets (x86, Raspberry Pi, VPS)
nodes.rationale: Multi-arch amd64+arm64 image required so the app runs on modest hardware; headless sidecar stays optional.

nodes.label: Modular monolith with one-way module imports
nodes.rationale: Small trusted group and single container; layered modules (db, auth, security, i18n) suffice without ports/adapters.

nodes.label: proxy.ts edge-safe guard (cookie presence only)
nodes.rationale: Next 16 renamed middleware to proxy; kept edge-safe, real session validation in getCurrentUser().

nodes.label: Session tokens and CSRF Origin check
nodes.rationale: Random 32-byte token stored as SHA-256 hash; Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site check plus SameSite=Lax instead of per-form token.
